CustomField.description: This person's own survey link secret, minted by GxFeedbackDispatch. It is the only thing that opens their survey: the booking number in the link is for the reader, because a group booking and every participant booking under it share one number. Unique and case sensitive so two guests can never share a link, and an external id so the lookup is indexed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The guest's personal link secret. Set automatically; never edit or share it.
CustomField.label: Secret
